decisions.reason: COVID froze aviation demand, so the app's value is still unresolved, and keeping a digital app on the market costs little while touchless check-in gains relevance as travel recovers in 2022.

PassBoard was launched with prominence as the flagship processing platform, and the pandemic prevented any real test of its value, so the option is worth holding cheaply until airport volumes recover.

Self-service check-in fits post-pandemic contactless processing trends and builds on the PassBoard platform, so uncertainty remains high and abandoning it now would forfeit the upside at little saving.
